column5: Campaign 22 uses one stock MySQL connection and one retained Rust SQL-node process against three real PD and three real TiKV nodes while the table-region leader moves A-to-B-to-C-to-restarted-B. Exact rows, physical address, ChannelPool version, later BatchCommands stream generation, a real blocked TiKV publication, ordered fallible shutdown, zero exit status, and tag-owned cleanup are asserted. The proof remains bounded to one configured read-only table, one local topology, and a failpoint-enabled TiDB v8.5.6 fixture used only for setup and the deterministic lock barrier; broader RealTiKV suites and TiDB semantics remain open.
